findings.text: follow-on: the listing arm claims to report only "a file naming no run at all, which no peer produces", but reckon/_store.py:508 writes every live pointer through a sibling temporary named .<name>.<pid>.<token>.tmp in that same directory, so a peer's in-flight pointer write can appear in the after-listing as an entry that names no run (read after the rename it raises OSError and _named_run_id returns None), which is the residual false positive the commit set out to remove.

JUSTIFICATION durability: the added assertions at tests/test_a_pick_sees_each_lanes_burn.py:181-188 fail if _writes_into_the_live_home reports nothing or reports a peer's well-formed pointer, and the table mapping the refactor now leans on is guarded by test_one_window_carries_both_the_rate_and_the_even_share at tests/test_a_pick_sees_each_lanes_burn.py:375, which reddens at 43.0/12.0 if 10080 resolves to five_hour.

JUSTIFICATION reuse: the change deletes the duplicate NAMED_WINDOW_MINUTES at the old budget.py:814 and extends the module's existing owner WINDOW_MINUTES_CLOCK at reckon/budget.py:807, and the guard helpers wrap the existing traces_naming at tests/real_home_traces.py:42 rather than forking it.
